<!-- Typesetting specimen. Placeholder text, not a proposed provision. -->

(a) A peacemaker may keep a record of the date, place and participants of a peacemaking session, but not of what was said.

(b) A record kept under subsection (a) is held by {{nation.name}} for the period its law sets for court records.
